headline: LPL Financial Reports Q3 Growth Amid Ongoing Acquisition Integrations
summary: LPL Financial posted strong third-quarter revenue growth, while investors monitored progress and costs surrounding the integration of recent acquisitions.
why: LPL Financial is one of the largest independent broker-dealers in the United States, managing hundreds of billions in client assets.

impacts.name: LPL Financial Holdings Inc.
impacts.why: Organic asset expansion is balanced against platform integration expenses and client retention risks.
